author: Zegita
body:
IGN: Zegita
Why was I banned?: I have no idea but apparently I was "click aimbot" ("You have been punsihed by Velenoso for Hacking-click aimbot" on May 24th 2015. I was just playing a game normally and once again I get banned without no proof, no video evidence nothing. It's getting to a point where I do not understand why I'm being banned: is it just me being good or clicking too fast because I am willing to screenshare any moderator/senior moderator and this I'm sorry to say Avicus but this is bad staff management. I respect all your staff members but if they can not detect what's hacking and what's not and then I believe it's an issue.
Why I feel I should be unbanned?: Lol cuz I don't hack I have my own youtube channel who people watch me 1v1s and other pvp videos I would not risk losing my subs for "hacking". It's pathetic. So please understand this Avicus and please I 100% do not hack. I'll be honest that I had done so in the past about 5/6 months ago but that's in the past and we're talking about now. I feel this is a huge error because just cuz I can kill so many players on nebula, mods believe I was hacking but with no proof just their word against my useless word :/.

Thank you for taking your time for reading this and I hope you can come to a reasonable decision. Thank you :)

-Zegita or ZegitaHD(YT channel)
